task: F4-2 l=0 even modes, MRV Appendix B at j^2=0
convention: S = int dt dr [K0 chidot^2 - G0 chi^2 - M0 chi^2] with chi^2 -> chi-prime^2 for G0; coefficients include sqrt(-g) as in Appendix B. Normalised values K0/J^2, G0/J^2 also reported.

structural.alpha_drops: every alpha term in eq. (action_even) carries an explicit j^2 (j^2 a4 alpha', j^2 a9 alpha, j^2 b5 alphadot, j^2 c5 alpha, j^2 d1..d4); at j^2=0 alpha is absent. It also multiplies d_a Y_00 = 0.
structural.H1_multiplier: kinetic term j^2 b_1 H_1^2 = 0 at j^2=0; constraint d/dt[b_2 chi' + b_3 chi + b_4 H_2]=0 integrated to Q=0 with vanishing integration constant (localised perturbations).
structural.b2_b4_proportionality: b_2 = -2 a_1/A and b_4 = -2 a_3/A hold identically (A=1) by the printed formulas.
structural.finding: The Horndeski part of a_2 satisfies the H0/H1 constraint identity b_3 = 2(a_1' - a_2) to 7e-15; the printed a_2^BH breaks it by exactly -4 pi'^3 F_4 (agreement to 8e-15). Independent confirmation: the paper's a_5 identity a_5 = -J^2 dE_A/dpi = a_2' - a_1'' holds with a_2^H to 5.9e-6 (FD floor) but fails by 0.213 with printed a_2. As printed the two constraints would over-determine chi; the consistent reduction (used here) eliminates via the H_1 bracket, and a_2 then drops out of the reduced action entirely. Logged as an Appendix B inconsistency, same class as the F4-4 E_J transcription finding.

pole.K0_G0_behaviour: both ~ +1/D^2, positive on both sides (shared parametrisation singularity of the chi variable at the xi-denominator zero)

throat.note: K0 and G0 both vanish quadratically at r=0 (K0 ~ 0.97 r^2, G0 ~ 0.76 r^2, ratio -> ~0.789): the J'^2 degeneracy, mirroring det K, det G ~ J'^2 at l>=1. No 1/J' artefact survives at l=0: every 1/J' in Appendix B (d_3, e_4) multiplies j^2. Coefficients are finite (zero, not singular) at the throat.

K0.negative_region: r < -12.32 (within [-60,60]); K0/J^2 -> -2/tau^2 = -0.02 as r -> -inf (analytic leading term)

G0.note: G0 > 0 everywhere on [-60,60] except the throat point itself, where it vanishes quadratically (see throat fits)

anatomy.driver: K0 < 0 for r < -12.32 as printed. Leading asymptotic K0/J^2 -> -2/tau^2 (r -> -inf) vs +2/tau^2 (r -> +inf): the sign is set by the single parity-odd term of printed e_1, -H B^2 J'^2/(J X A) d/dr(J^2 A/B) = -2 J'^3/X.

u0_parity_control.note: for u=0 the construction is manifestly r -> -r symmetric, yet K0(40) - K0(-40) = 62.0891 equals exactly twice the odd part of printed e_1 at 40, -J'^3/X = 31.0446: the J'^3 term is the ONLY asymmetry in K0. That term is invisible in Kobayashi's J=r original (J'=1). Its J-general form as printed is therefore suspect — but see next entry: no variant rescues positivity.

anatomy.conclusion: Even part of K0 at |r|=40 is already negative (-3.88, u=0 control); removing the suspect term leaves K0 -> ~ -4 at BOTH infinities, flipping it moves the ghost to r > 0. Within the printed coefficient set no single-term repair of e_1 makes K0 positive everywhere.

c3_validation.note: the shifted-pi machinery reproduces the paper's a_5 identity to 5.9e-6 (FD floor) when a_5 is built from the Horndeski part of a_2 — validating c_3 and confirming independently that printed a_2^BH is the inconsistent piece (dev 0.213 with printed a_2)

M0.definition: M0 in S = int [K0 chidot^2 - G0 chi'^2 - M0 chi^2]; singular at the D=0 pole like K0/G0 (same chi-parametrisation); extrema quoted for |r - r*| > 1
M0.sign_summary: M0(0) ~ 0 (5e-7) and M0 > 0 at all sampled radii except a negative pocket on the positive side of the throat, 0 <~ r <~ 0.77 (min -3.05 at r = 0.77); at large |r| M0 -> ~ +0.019. This pocket is the l=0 tachyon input for F4-3 (its sign alone is not a verdict here).
M0.caveat: e_3 from FD pi-shift of the EL_pi functional (p44b route); absolute normalisation is the reduced-action one (E_pi = EL_pi/J^2).

ell_limit_note: det K and det G (eqs. detK/detG) carry (l-1)(l+2) in the numerator but l(l+1) = j^2 in the denominator, and K_11 carries [j^2 P_1 - F]/j^2: as l -> 0 these diverge or flip sign (K_11 -> -F/j^2). The divergence is manufactured by the l>=1 reduction itself, which divides by j^2 when solving the H_0 constraint for alpha (eq. alpha). At l=0 alpha does not exist, H_1 degenerates to a multiplier, and the constraint structure is different: the l=0 reduction above is independent, not a limit.
verdict: FAIL — K0 < 0 for r in [-60, -12.32] (ghost in the spherically symmetric even sector, negative side, K0/J^2 -> -0.02 at -inf), beyond tolerance by ~4 orders of magnitude. G0 > 0 everywhere (vanishing only quadratically at the throat). Anatomy in res.anatomy: the sign is driven by printed e_1, whose J'^3 term is parity-anomalous (suspected misprint in the J-generalisation), but the even part of K0 is also negative at large |r| and no single-term repair restores positivity. Reopening: a corrected Appendix B e_1 / a_2^BH, or an independent l=0 derivation from the covariant action.
